ai_bot.title: AI Assistant
ai_bot.welcome_message:
Hello! I'm your POS AI Assistant. I can help you with business stats, customer info, installment data, financial reports, and more.

Try asking me questions like:
• How many customers do we have?
• Show me today's dues
• What is the outstanding balance?
• Who are the defaulters?
• Show me profit and loss
ai_bot.placeholder: Ask me anything about your business...
ai_bot.key_hint: For smarter AI responses, add your xAI (Grok) API key. Without it, the bot uses built-in intelligence.
